source_intent: Huber loss of feature-linear residual on full Euclidean space; derive convexity and gradient, bounded features imply bounded gradients, constant horizon eta proportional1/sqrtT gives vanishing upper average regret against any fixed predictor.

formal_choices.threshold: delta>=0, including delta0; negative thresholds do not define a convex Huber loss
formal_choices.schedule: eta=1/sqrtT independent of comparator/future losses; known horizon T>=1
formal_choices.conclusion: one-sided eventual average regret<epsilon, not convergence of absolute loss difference

definition_2_16_followup: Real-threshold closedness and indicator closed/proper scratch candidates are separate from Huber acceptance.
